title: Field & Stream Garment-Dyed Hoodie (XL)

comparisons.notes: Men's Holloa French Terry Hoodie, Cappuccino / X-Large, SKU 2035-3003-130/00XL matching the Woot item's MPN (UPC 810199101231). In stock.

writeup: Field & Stream's Holloa garment-dyed French terry hoodie in Brown/Cappuccino, men's XL (MPN 2035-3003-130/00XL), is $23.99 new on Woot. Field & Stream's own shop sells the same variant for $79, so this is about 69% below the cheapest store we found. It has a hidden phone pocket inside the kangaroo pouch, and Woot showed only 1 left.
